## Setup

I want length-7 strings over {0,...,9}, digit sum exactly 30, no two adjacent digits equal.

**Recurrence** (adjacency forbids repeating the previous digit):
$$f_k(s,d) = \sum_{d'\ne d} f_{k-1}(s-d,d') = T_{k-1}(s-d) - f_{k-1}(s-d,d),\quad 0\le d\le 9.$$

This enforces all three constraints at once: digits capped at 0–9 (we only ever add $d\in\{0,\dots,9\}$), exact sum (we index by exact $s$), and no equal adjacency (the $d'\ne d$ exclusion). Length is exactly 7 (six transition steps from the length-1 base).
